command(python -c "
import urllib.request, json, ssl
ctx = ssl._create_unverified_context()
headers = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
    'Accept': 'application/json'
}
req = urllib.request.Request('https://dadosabertos.web.stj.jus.br/api/3/action/package_show?id=integras-de-decisoes-terminativas-e-acordaos-do-diario-da-justica', headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx, timeout=30) as resp:
    data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    resources = data['result']['resources']
    
    # Agrupar por data
    by_date = {}
    for r in resources:
        name = r.get('name', '')
        fmt = r.get('format', '').upper()
        # extrair data do nome (ex: metadados20260824 ou 20260824.zip)
        digits = ''.join([c for c in name if c.isdigit()])
        if len(digits) == 8:
            d = digits
            if d not in by_date:
                by_date[d] = {}
            by_date[d][fmt] = {
                'url': r.get('url'),
                'size': r.get('size'),
                'name': name
            }
    
    sorted_dates = sorted(by_date.keys(), reverse=True)
    print(f'Total de dias com publicações: {len(sorted_dates)}')
    print('Últimos 10 dias disponíveis:')
    for d in sorted_dates[:10]:
        fmt_str = f'{d[6:8]}/{d[4:6]}/{d[0:4]}'
        has_meta = 'JSON' in by_date[d]
        has_zip = 'ZIP' in by_date[d]
        print(f'- Data: {fmt_str} (ID: {d}) | Metadados JSON: {has_meta} | Textos ZIP: {has_zip}')
")

command(python -c "
import os, json, urllib.request, ssl

ctx = ssl._create_unverified_context()
headers = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
    'Accept': 'application/json'
}

base_dir = r'D:\Extrai1\Monocráticas'
existing_files = set(os.listdir(base_dir))

url = 'https://dadosabertos.web.stj.jus.br/api/3/action/package_show?id=integras-de-decisoes-terminativas-e-acordaos-do-diario-da-justica'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx, timeout=30) as resp:
    data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

resources = data['result']['resources']
allowed = ['zip', 'json', 'csv']

missing = []
for r in resources:
    name = r.get('name', '')
    fmt = r.get('format', '').lower()
    if fmt not in allowed:
        continue
    ext = f'.{fmt}'
    fname = name if name.lower().endswith(ext) else f'{name}{ext}'
    if fname not in existing_files:
        missing.append({
            'name': fname,
            'url': r.get('url'),
            'format': fmt,
            'size': r.get('size')
        })

print(f'Total de recursos no STJ: {len(resources)}')
print(f'Arquivos já existentes em {base_dir}: {len(existing_files)}')
print(f'Total de arquivos PENDENTES a partir do último: {len(missing)}')
if missing:
    print('Primeiros 5 pendentes:', [m['name'] for m in missing[:5]])
    print('Últimos 5 pendentes:', [m['name'] for m in missing[-5:]])
")
